reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web profile plugin that replaces the built-in Effort dropdown with a draggable three-position slider while preserving the underlying model-selection IDs and existing Harness services.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web profile 提供带鼠标和键盘操作的三档 Effort 滑块界面，并保留原有模型选择流程。
summaries.en: Provides a mouse- and keyboard-operable three-position Effort slider for the DeepSeek Harness Web profile while preserving the existing model-selection flow.

capabilities: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness model Effort selector with a three-position slider in the web interface
Passes the original Effort IDs back through the existing session.selectModel flow
Embeds avatar images as data URLs for the interface
